svg.title: NeelKIT system architecture
svg.desc: Clients talk to the neelkitd Go server over REST and WebSocket. Audio flows through a realtime session with Silero VAD, Parakeet speech recognition, transcript repair and an intent router (grammar first, optional local LLM). The assistant passes proposed tool calls through a policy gate and an os.Root sandbox confined to one workspace folder. State is kept in SQLite.

svg.text: Everything runs on your machine. Solid arrows follow one spoken command from microphone to result.
